* **Privacy Policy:** *"ValidatorAI.com ('Validator AI') values its users' privacy. This Privacy Policy ('Policy') will help you understand how we collect and use personal information from those who visit our website or make use of our online facilities and services..."*
* **About Page:** *"ValidatorAI was created by Aron Meystedt..."* / *"Founded by Aron Meystedt"*

No separate formal legal corporate entity is designated on the website.
